title: Boats and Burgers Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Vegetarian and vegan options are available
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Savor a delightful two-hour cruise on Lake Minnetonka aboard a spacious two-story yacht, featuring a narrated journey past stunning homes, parks, and marinas. Enjoy mouthwatering cheeseburgers alongside all the fixings, chips with dip, pasta salad, fresh fruit, and cookies for dessert. Beer, wine, and cocktails are available for purchase, ensuring a refreshing experience as you take in the scenic beauty of the lake. Perfect for families and friends looking for a casual dining experience on the water.

- Two-hour narrated cruise around Big Island on Lake Minnetonka
- Mouthwatering cheeseburgers, chips, and desserts included
- Beer, wine, and cocktails available for purchase
- Scheduled on Wednesdays and Sundays at designated times
